review.tagline: Python library of classical machine learning algorithms built on NumPy and SciPy
review.summary: scikit-learn is a Python module for machine learning built on SciPy, started in 2007 as a Google Summer of Code project. It installs with pip or conda and requires Python 3.12 or newer, NumPy, SciPy, Narwhals, joblib and threadpoolctl. Plotting helpers need Matplotlib. The README does not list the algorithms; those are documented on the website.
review.audience: Python developers and data scientists building classical ML models
strengths: Installs with one pip or conda command; six required dependencies, all listed with minimum versions
BSD-3-Clause license; test suite runs with pytest sklearn
Volunteer community with institutional support; benchmarked with asv
Test randomness is controllable through the SKLEARN_SEED environment variable
weaknesses: README does not mention GPU support
Requires Python 3.12 or newer, which excludes older environments
README gives no algorithm list; readers must consult the website
needs: Needs Python >= 3.12, NumPy >= 1.26.0, SciPy >= 1.11.4, Narwhals >= 2.0.1, joblib >= 1.4.0, threadpoolctl >= 3.5.0
